item: Row 397: the Who, Where and When columns say when they were cut
summary: Anti-capping, the same shape as row 395. corpus_who/corpus_where/corpus_when kept limit=40 groups and returned only count=len(rows), so a corpus naming 300 people showed 40 chips that read as all of them. Each now also counts every distinct group in the matched set (total, truncated; additive keys, the empty set carries them too) and each cut column says '{shown} of {total} shown.' with the existing x12 key; an older payload says nothing. corpus_when dropped an unreadable year AFTER the limit, so a null bucket took a place and the column came back short while more years existed; the filter now runs before the limit. The deduced-from-text caveat above the columns is unchanged. simple.js slices to 4-5 on purpose and is untouched.
